questions.prompt: How many times does Orbit Scheduler retry a failed task?
questions.answer: Up to five times with exponential backoff.
questions.sourceQuote: retries it up to five times with exponential backoff

questions.prompt: When does the first retry happen and how do later delays change?
questions.answer: After thirty seconds, and each following delay doubles the previous one.
questions.sourceQuote: The first retry happens after thirty seconds

questions.prompt: What happens after the fifth failure?
questions.answer: The task is marked as broken and an alert is sent to the configured webhook.
questions.sourceQuote: the task is marked as broken

questions.answer: By a cron expression and a command.
questions.sourceQuote: described by a cron expression and a command

questions.prompt: How many task runs does the rolling history keep?
questions.sourceQuote: rolling history of the last one thousand task runs

questions.prompt: On which interface does the web dashboard listen by default?
questions.answer: Only on the loopback interface, unless bind_address is changed.
questions.sourceQuote: listens only on the loopback interface

questions.prompt: When does a dashboard session expire?
questions.sourceQuote: expires after fifteen minutes of inactivity
